Biotite granite on SE side of Bravo Hills, foliated with ductile shearing (late magmatic) producing drag folds in foliation.  47 pieces + fragments.  Took boulder sample tentatively until we what is available.
properties.Notes: Biotite granite on SE side of Bravo Hills, foliated with ductile shearing (late magmatic) producing drag folds in folia.   Foliation is cut by more steeply dipping pegmatites and aplites.

properties.SampleDesc: sheared diorite
properties.Notes: Sheared, foliated dioritic rock.  Appears like upper greenschist-lower amphibolite schist along some zones.  Where dioritic rock remains, there are clear augen of plagioclase.  Rock has a distinct cleavage with a phyllitic sheen on S1 surface formed by m

properties.SampleDesc: "Skinner granite"  Granite has occasional titanite. K-feldspar phenocrysts become pinkish in some areas.  Elongate mafic enclaves are also K-feldspar phenocryst bearing. Porphyritic hornblende-biotite granite with moderate dipping pegmatites.  58 pieces
properties.Notes: Weakly developed flow foliation - more distinct in alignment of xenoliths.  Pegmatites like BVH-1C, have garnets.  Granite has occasional titanite

properties.SampleDesc: Equigranular 'Catspaw type' granite w smokey gray quartz. Unfoliated.
properties.Notes: Intrudes (Skinner) type granite - sharp contact.  No mafic xenoliths.

Inclusions in phonolite flow downslope from AW84760. Rounded, vesicular, feldspar (2%) basalt in aphyric, platy phonolite.
Non vesicular, platy, feldspar (<<1%)-olivine basalt.
Thick basanite flow on bench north of AW84720.  1m thick flow outcropping below camp (collected by J. Moore).  Vesicular, feldspar (<1%)-olivine (1%) basalt with resorbing felsic inclusions; fresh.
Lowermost flow on 2nd ridge west from Camp 1.  Feldspar and kaersutite megacrysts in vesicular aphyric basalt; fresh.
Middle of sequence above AW84764.  Vesicular, scoriaceous, clinopyroxene/kaersutite (<1%) -olivine (4%) basalt.  Some salt deposits.
Dike cutting cinder cone sequence above AW84764-AW84765.  Finely vesicular, clinopyroxene/kaersutite-olivine basalt with scattered kaersutite megacrysts; fresh.
Basanite flow underlying the unconformity at base of Southeast Cape section.  Vesicular, clinopyroxene/kaersutite (2%)-feldspar (2%) basalt.  Iron oxide coatings on vesicles.
Lava tongues in breccia of phonolite dome.  Kaersutite phonolite with devitrified glassy texture.
Basal flow of basalt flow sequence abutting phonolite dome at point of section at SE Cape.  Clinopyroxene (2%)-olivine (7%) basalt (partial oxidation of olivines).

Breccia outcrop above clinopyroxene basalt flow sequence.  Angular, clast supported, lapilli breccia of vesicular, glassy basalt with partial, palagonite matrix, with extensive secondary white mineralization.
Lowermost flow in sequence above AW84771 which is not associated with glassy basal flow breccia.  Vesicular, olivine (1%) basalt with some secondary mineralization coating vesicles.
Basalt flow overlying laharic - strombolian sequence at ~880' up section.  Non vesicular, clinopyroxene/kaersutite (2%)-olivine (2%) basalt.  Secondary white mineralization along fractures; fresh.
Basalt flow at 1130' elevation up sequence.  Non vesicular, clinopyroxene/kaersutite (3%)-olivine (3%) basalt with occasional feldspar megacrysts; fresh.
Platy flow at 1180' overlying AW84774.  Platy, kaersutite (1%) phonolite with alteration and secondary white mineralization along platy surfaces.
Scoriaceous flow base to platy green flow at 1240' elevation.  Finely vesicular, feldspar (1%) phonolite.
Lowermost of the green phonolite flows near the middle of the Southeast Cape section. Non vesicular, platy feldspar (<<1%)-kaersutite (<<1%) phonolite; fresh
Uppermost platy green flow in section at SE cape.  Vesicular, platy, kaersutite (1%)-feldspar (2%) phonolite; partially altered.
Flow (1.5m thick).  Very vesicular, feldspar (3%) phonolite with partial alteration of feldspars.
Overlying flow with hyaloclastite breccia above and below.  Non vesicular, feldspar (<1%)-olivine (2%)-clinopyroxene/kaersutite (5%) basalt; fresh.
Flow beneath welded cinder cone.  Vesicular, feldspar (<<1%)-clinopyroxene/kaersutite (1%)-olivine (4%) basalt.  Some salt and secondary mineral deposits).
Thick columnar jointed flow above cinder cone.  Non vesicular, feldspar (<1%)-clinopyroxene/kaersutite (3%)-olivine (5%) basalt; fresh.
Patchy outcrop of basalt flow through scree.  Partially oxidized, olivine (<<1%)- clinopyroxene/kaersutite (7%) basalt.
Unconformity at hydrothermal gully.  Base of sedimentary sequence at unconformity.  Crystal-lithic grit in matrix and clast support.  Degree of matrix varies with lamina bedding.
Above AW84784A.  Lithic lapilli, floating in crystal-lithic or altered vitric tuff.  Massive in hand specimen.
Above AW84784B.  Graded crystal-vitric-lithic lapilli tuff with occasionally angular floating pebble size lithic clasts.  Citric clasts devitrified.
Hyaloclastite breccia below unconformity, at hydrothermal gully.  Kaersutite (1%)-feldspar (7%) glassy basalt with secondary white mineralization along fractures; small.
Phonolite scree from gully above dike.  Medium grained, aphyric phonolite; fresh.
Basalt flow below unconformity at base of bluff to S of Hydrothermal Gully.  Slightly vesicular, kaersutite (1%)-feldspar (2%) basalt.  Feldspar is altering; not fresh.
Some locality as AW84787.  ?Glacial striae on truncated basalt surface.
Small outcrop at base of bluff on east side of SE Cape.  Vesicular, kaersutite (3%) phonolite with white secondary minerals in vesicles and along fractures.
Tuff overlying unconformity at SE Cape.  Completely hydrated, angular, lithic (phonolite) lapilli tuff, in matrix support in crystal lithic tuff.
Breccia overlying AW84790.  Heterolithic, angular breccia containing vesicular kaersutite phonolite clasts in matrix supported coarse ash tuff, now hydrated.
Platy trachyte dome below the unconformity. Very platy ?intrusion behind Camp 1. Extremely platy, yellow-green trachyte with indistinct phenocrysts. Looks vaguely peralkaline.
Same lava mass as AW84791, higher up, less platy.  Less platy than AW84791, devitrified, glassy lava with scattered feldspar phenocrysts.
Lobe basalt flow overlying the trachyte mass of AW84791-792.  Neon vesicular, olivine (1%)- clinopyroxene/kaersutite (2%) basalt.  Olivines are mostly oxidized.
Near base of bluff to east of Camp 1.  Flows seem to cascade down slope from above unconformity.  Olivine (1%)-clinopyroxene/kaersutite (3%) basalt.  Olivines are oxidized.
Lava flow from below unconformity.  Slightly vesicular, olivine (<1%)-clinopyroxene/kaersutite (2%) basalt.  Olivines are oxidized.

Flow lenses below the unconformity.  Flow lenses surrounded by flow breccia in outcrop below radially jointed flow.  Non vesicular, olivine (<1%)-clinopyroxene/kaersutite (2%) basalt.  Olivines are partially oxidized.

Flow tongue embedded in palagonitized sediment associated with the unconformity. Above AW84796 and below radially jointed flow; complex unconformity. Non vesicular, olivine (2%) - clinopyroxene/kaersutite (2%) basalt. Only slight oxidation of olivine.

Base at west end Birthday Bluffs. Least altered clasts in breccia.  Hematite veined, bleached white trachyte with some SiO2 and quartz deposition.  Clasts are fractured and rounded; some even may be liquid deformed.
50cm thick bed intercalated with breccia.  Base of west end Birthday Bluffs.  ?Silicic, grained tuff beds
6m above AW85801, similar horizon.  ? Welded crystal vitric tuff (or ?silicified).
Early dike truncated by local unconformity near base of west end of Birthday Bluffs. 3m wide dike truncated by unconformity above AW85802.  Feldspar phyric trachyte with hematite alteration.
Bulbous branching dikes above unconformity, first spur, west end Birthday Bluffs.  Medium grained, equigranular, non vesicular, gray trachyte.  Flow banded, slightly oxidized.
Brecciated intrusive plug, lower, west Birthday Bluffs.  Aphyric, greenish gray, massive trachyte, fine grained.
Mineralization associated with dike intrusion into lowermost flow, west end Birthday Bluffs.  Gypsum flower crystals, 1-3cm long and unknown black mineral.
Clasts in breccia adjacent to AW85806.  Silicified gray agglomerates of rounded porphyritic and aphyric clasts dominantly non vesicular, in matrix support in gray cherty matrix.

Green alteration of breccia adjacent to AW85807 and AW85808.  Matrix supported homolithic breccia with fine silicified tuff matrix that is altered dark olive green.  Clasts are also altered but less so and are rounded to sub angular, feldspar phyric trac
Trachyte dike cutting flow AW83508 at head embayment. Cutting flow on South side of 2nd spur, west end Birthday Bluffs.  Coarse aenigmatite trachyte.
Breccia below pillow basalts, in slope above camp.  Vesicular, aphyric, basalt clasts in trachytic, heterolithic lapilli tuff in lapilli support.  Interpreted as a phreatomagmatic deposit.
Top of BB [Birthday Bluff] section, top of flow at top of bluff.  Flow banded feldspar trachyte
Truncated dike on Jim's spur to west of BB.  Finely vesicular, aphyric, gray trachyte.
Yellow outcrop in scree below top of dome/flow in BB section [Birthday Bluff].  Unsorted pumice-obsidian-feldspar lapilli tuff with ash support matrix.  Pumice and vitric shards altered.
Flow in BB section.  Either part of dome/flow or 2nd BB flow.  Green, slightly vesicular, aphyric trachyte.
Same unit as AW85814.  Fine grained, green, aphyric trachyte and autobreccia.
Lowermost 'thick' flow in BB section, Unit 4.  Massive, glassy, trachyte with rare pyroxene phenocryst.
Breccia cropping out at spur 3.  Bleached, feldspar phyric trachyte breccia with limonite and thin quartz and chalcedony veins.
Trachyte flow at base of third spur up on west of Birthday Bluffs. Coarse grained peralkaline trachyte.  Numerous feldspar phenocrysts and possible areas of devitrified glass.
Pillow lobes of hyaloclastite at east end Windscoop bluff.  Green, feldspar phyric peralkaline trachyte.
Base of outcrop, east end Windscoop Bluff.  Scoriaceous to massive flow.  Banded, dark gray ?trachyandesite from bomb material.  Some limonite veining. Aphyric lava.
Base of outcrop, east end Windscoop Bluff.  Welded lapilli tuff of scoriaceous cinder clasts.  Significant alteration.  Probably trachyandesite or trachyte.
Base of outcrop near east end Windscoop Bluff.  Very bleached trachytic lapilli tuff with interesting dark green alteration, probably due to silicification.
Bomb agglutinate from middle Windscoop Bluff near base of outcrop.  Gray, vesicular trachyte, with some ilmenite deposits.
2nd dike up the central valley at Windscoop Bluff.  Vesicular, gray, clinopyroxene-olivine-feldspar basalt; coarse grained.
Thin flow near top of obsidian breccia at Windscoop Bluff.  Scoriaceous to glassy flow banded, greenish gray trachyte.
Flow overlying obsidian breccia.  Dark gray, glassy feldspar trachyte.
Breccia below thin flow mantled by tuff wedge on saddle to west of Windscoop Bluff.  Oxidized, pumiceous and massive lapilli (trachyte) in matrix supported gray ash.
Uppermost, massive flow on ridge above west end Windscoop Bluff, on ridge at top of Birthday Bluffs..  Medium grained, green, peralkaline feldspar trachyte.
Trachyte dike intruding trachytic agglutinate at far eastern end of the base of Grassham Bluff.  Coarse aenigmatite-feldspar trachyte.
Thin trachyte flow interbedded with agglutinate; east end of Grassham Bluff at the base  Aphyric trachyandesite
Flow overlying AW85831 with pahoehoe texture.  Glassy, aphyric trachyte.
Thick green flow at base of east end of the bluffs; overlying AW85831 with platy texture.  Fine grained, green, aphyric trachyte.
Overlying platy flow at 2230' elevation.  Very green, aphyric, vesicular trachyte with limonite staining in voids and fractures.
Unoxidized trachytic agglutinate. Green, finely vesicular trachyte with feldspar phenocrysts.  Rounded 2cm inclusion of aenigmatite-Na pyroxene-feldspar.
Trachyte agglutinate.  Gray feldspar phyric, scoriaceous trachyte.
Platy trachyte flow overlying trachyte agglutinate and tuff in the upper part of Grassham Bluffs.  Finely flow banded, glassy aphyric trachyte.
Erebus crystals
Platy flow above AW85837.  Gray, vesicular, flow banded trachyte.
Olivine basalt clasts in breccia.  Massive, fine grained olivine basalt.
Flow forming ridge crest above east end Windscoop Bluff.  Vesicular, flow banded, green-gray trachyte; aphyric.
Flow below AW85841.  Vesicular, bomb-like, inclusion of dark gray, aphyric, ?trachyte in greenish feldspar phyric trachyte.
Lava pod (probably dike) at lower end of ridge behind Camp 1.  Medium grained, aenigmatite-feldspar lava, with feldspar phenocrysts.
Clast from breccia on lower end of ridge behind camp.  Glassy, flow banded, feldspar trachyte.
Mineralization in Funnel dike lava.  Botryoidal limonite deposits.
Porphyritic, wavy dike through breccias above Funnel dike.  Gray, finely vesicular, feldspar trachyte.
Base of trachyte flow cascading south from Anniversary Bluff.  Coarse grained aenigmatite-feldspar-aegirine-augite trachyte.
Trachyte dike intruding far west end Anniversary Bluff at base.  Coarsely crystalline, feldspar rich trachyte.
Lapilli tuff at base of bluff, west end Anniversary Bluff.  Very altered lapilli tuff.

Inclusion bearing dike cutting AW85847.  Trachyte dike and inclusions in gully near west end Anniversary Bluff.  Rounded inclusions from dike.  Vesicular, feldspar-kaersutite ?trachyandesite with SiO2 lining vesicles.
Late dike intruded parallel to the front of Anniversary Bluff.  Vesicular trachyandesite with secondary limonite in vesicles form inclusions in aphyric trachyte.
Sandstone front top of the sedimentary sequence.  Well sorted, bedded, lithic arkose with some alteration of feldspars.
Top of Anniversary dome.  Feldspar-aenigmatite trachyte
Accretionary lapilli tuff in saddle behind Anniversary dome.  Very altered, accretionary lapilli tuff

Trachyte flow on east side of the Anniversary dome below snow slope.  Very coarse grained, Na-pyroxene, aenigmatite-feldspar trachyte with late aenigmatite in flow joints.  Feldspar-phyric, some chalcedony deposition in voids.
Earliest dike at base of the island.  Feldspar-phyric, fine grained, gray trachyte with Fe alteration of feldspar and incipient limonization.
Later, multiply intruded dike set at base of the island.  Medium grained, aphyric gray trachyte.
As for AW85857 [Later, multiply intruded dike set at base of the island.]  Massive, green, fine grained trachyte with scattered feldspar phenocrysts - similar to AW85856.
Lower peralkaline trachyte flow at back of island, overlain by breccias.  Feldspar rich, green peralkaline flow with aenigmatite alteration.
Platy trachyte flow exposed on the eastern side of Green Island. Coarse, equigranular Na-pyroxene feldspar trachyte
Platy trachyte flow above island.  Coarse, equigranular Na-pyroxene feldspar trachyte.
Clast from breccia overlying AW86860. Coarsely crystalline clasts in ?lahar breccia.  Coarse kaersutite-feldspar intergrowths-plutonic.
Aphyric lava flow east of dike swarm. Wedge of massive lava at base of east side of island. Dark gray, almost aphyric trachyandesite with occasional feldspar crystals.
Lowermost thick trachyte flow at west end Birthday Bluffs.  Feldspar and Na-pyroxene phyric peralkaline trachyte with bands of Fe oxidization.
Flow forming second spur up at west end of Birthday Bluffs. Lowermost flow in west end BB.   Feldspar phyric peralkaline trachyte with feldspars largely altered to black.
White, banded dike through AW85865. Bleached and partially silicified trachyte dike with knots of ?aenigmatite concentrated in bands.
Dike to east of AW85868 cutting through same cliff.  Feldspar phenocryst rich, trachytic peralkaline trachyte.
Flow banded variation of AW85855 at east side of Anniversary Bluff.  Flow banded, peralkaline trachyte.
Wide green trachyte dike at tip of Dads Nose; cutting obliquely across the extreme end of Dads Nose.  Coarse, feldspar phyric peralkaline syenite.
Breccia dike at Dads Nose.  Slightly heterolithic breccia of angular to rounded green and much fewer white trachytic clasts in welded tuffaceous matrix.  Max clast size in sample - 2cm.
Sample from scree in next embayment west of Dads Nose.  White with micaceous sheen, altered feldspar trachyte but feldspar phenocrysts look fresh.  Porous from loss of altered minerals.
Brecciated zone in massive lava lobe at Dads Nose.  Quartz and black and rose calcite plates in open cracks.  Quartz crystallization later.

Orange tuff bed in center of Birthday Bluffs.  Angular lapilli of glassy trachyte.  Red oxidized margins in grain support with ash to coarse ash matrix.  Minor feldspar phenocryst component is unaltered.
Greenish beds to west of AW85873.  Partially welded, greenish trachyte cinders; porous.
Bomb of gray trachyte from orange bed.  5cm diameter, rounded bomb of massive, essentially aphyric gray trachytic lava.
NW trending, late dike just to west of breccia dike at Dads Nose.  Feldspar-phyric, fine grained, green trachyte; massive and non vesicular.
Dike to west of Dads Nose, cut by fault gouge.  Coarse, trachytic textured, greenish gray, feldspar-phyric peralkaline trachyte.
Xenolith from hills north of Camp1, Hurricane Ridge.  Kaersutite and olivine pyroxenite nodules.
Small phonolite dome or flow remnant on SE lower flanks Mt. Discovery.  Coarse, kaersutite trachyte.
Same location as AW86881.  Rounded feldspar-kaersutite inclusions in trachyte.
Eroded phonolite dome adjacent to Ross Ice Shelf, east of AW86881. Aphyric trachyte
Same location as AW86883; adjacent to Ross Ice Shelf, east of AW86881. Aphyric vesicular trachyte.
Later phase of basanitic volcanism NW end, Minna Bluff.  Olivine basanite
As for AW85885.  Later phase of basanitic volcanism NW end, Minna Bluff.   Vesicular, olivine basanite.
Cinder cone on ridge. As for AW85885. Later phase of basanitic volcanism NW end, Minna Bluff. Coarse, aphyric trachyte.
Glaciated phonolite flow surface to west of AW86888 on north side of Mt. Discovery.  Aphyric phonolite.
Basalt flow overlying AW86889.  Massive, non-vesicular, clinopyroxene-olivine basalt.
Flow in crater of basanite cinder cone. NE side of Discovery, low elevation.  Olivine-kaersutite/clinopyroxene basanite.
Same location as AW86891; crater on NE side of  Discovery, low elevation.  Dull red, oxidized scoriaceous clinopyroxene basalt.
Xenocryst rich flow in south wall of small glacier to South of Camp II.  Finely vesicular clinopyroxene-olivine basalt.
Small outcrop of phonolite forms island in glacier above AW86893.  Vesicular, aphyric phonolite.
Xenoliths from phonolite outcrop in glacier. Vesicular inclusions within AW86894. Vesicular, feldspar phyric basalt looking rounded inclusions.
Glaciated benches above Camp II.  Feldspar-phyric basanite.
Benmoreite flow just below contact with overlying phonolite flow. Glaciated hawaiite flows on SE side of Discovery Dome. Kaersutite-feldspar-phyric benmoreite.
100' above survey stick, cavernously weathered phonolite flow. Vesicular, feldspar phyric phonolite; pale greenish gray
Middle of the outcrop of hawaiite flows. Hawaiite flows underlying phonolite further to west of AW86899. Glassy, coarsely feldspar-phyric benmoreite.
6-8m thick interflow hawaiite breccia below and west of AW86901.  Poorly sorted crystal-lithic lapilli tuff; massive in hand specimen.  Probably choked fluviatile deposit.
Phonolite flow remnant at base of dome slope.  Dark gray, feldspar-phyric phonolite.
Phonolite from same locality as AW86894.  Small outcrop forms island in glacier above AW86893.  Vesicular, aphyric phonolite.
Flow to SE of AW86904.  Massive, olivine - clinopyroxene/kaersutite basanite with minor oxidation alteration.
3rd cone up line of cinder cones running SE from Discovery Dome.  Partially oxidized aphyric basanite.
4th cone up.  Partially oxidized, vesicular, feldspar clinopyroxene basalt.
Top 'cone' nearest Discovery dome.  Partially oxidized, partly scoriaceous basanite.
Basanite flow forming bench.  Basanite flow at 6680' on Discovery dome.  Vesicular, clinopyroxene-feldspar-olivine basalt.
Tephrite flow cascading off higher slopes. Basanite flow overlying AW86909.  Olivine-clinopyroxene-feldspar basalt non-vesicular similar to AW86897.
Agglutinate with hawaiite inclusions overlying AW86910.  Oxidized, scoriaceous basanite with small phonolite inclusions <1cm and larger, vesicular hawaiite inclusions 5-8 cm across.
Basanite flow below ice cap on East side Discovery dome.  Scoriaceous, partially oxidized aphyric basalt.
Gray phonolite at 7850'.  Dark gray, vesicular phonolite with large scattered feldspar phenocrysts.
Basanite flow remnant overlying bomb lapilli tuff to north of Camp II.  Olivine-feldspar-clinopyroxene basanite, non-vesicular with small crustal xenoliths.
Platy phonolite flow on east side at base of Discovery dome.  Partially vesicular dark green gray phonolite with few feldspar phenocrysts.
Phonolite flow on east side Discovery dome.  Dark green gray, trachytic feldspar-phyric phonolite.
East side, Discovery dome.  Pale gray, feldspar phyric phonolite.
Overlying aphyric phonolite flow.  Dark gray, slightly platy aphyric flow.
Platy aphyric phonolite flow ? Above AW86918.  Flow banded, glassy, aphyric phonolite.

Sub crop of pumiceous lapilli near top of outcrop, east side Mt. Discovery.  Pale gray pumice clast 10cm across of aphyric phonolite with scattered lithic inclusions of feldspar phonolite <0.5cm across.
Small hawaiite ridge on east side of Mt. Discovery.  Large plagioclase phenocrysts and glomerocrysts in trachytic textured Benmoreite.
Small ridge of hawaiite.  Same area as AW86921.  on east side of Mt. Discovery.  Kaersutite-feldspar phonolite.
Scree clast in same area as AW921 & 922.  Foliated, porphyritic granite ?probably an inclusion.
Benched flows at base of Discovery cone on SE side.  Fresh, vesicular, aphyric basalt.
Area of interbedded flows and agglutinate south of Camp II.  Vesicular feldspar-clinopyroxene-olivine basalt with small pyroxenite inclusion, and clinopyroxene megacrysts.
Kaersutite nodule from glaciated cinder near AW86925.  Rounded kaersutite nodule 10cm across with considerable oxidation along crystal boundaries.
Basalt flow overlying phonolite outcrop on SE side of Mt. Discovery.  Vesicular clinopyroxene/kaersutite-feldspar basalt.  Feldspar may be xenocrystic.  Inclusion of foliated crustal rock.
Phonolite outcrops at 4910' on SE side Mt. Discovery.  Massive, buff colored, aphyric phonolite.
Dike intruding palagonitized bomb lapilli tuff on SE side Mt. Discovery.  Massive kaersutite-feldspar basalt.  Both feldspar and kaersutite are probably xenocrystic.
Dike cutting bomb and cinder between AW82928 and AW86929.  Rounded kaersutite nodules, cooked up crustal rocks and a large feldspar xenocryst.
Inclusions from glaciated agglutinate SE of AW86929.  Small rounded inclusions of kaersutite, crustal rocks, phonolite and a large feldspar crystal.
Cinder cone remnant in valley to North of Camp II.  Massive clinopyroxene-olivine basalt.
Crater at the terminal of the small glacier to north of Camp II.  Oxidized basanitic agglutinate.
Basanite flow to north of AW86933.  Vesicular, kaersutite-olivine basalt.
Phonolite outcrop to north of AW86934.  Slightly glassy, pyroxene-feldspar phonolite.
Basanite from overlying AW86935, 86937, 86938.  Slightly vesicular aphyric basanite.
Phonolite outcrop East side Discovery.  Greenish-gray phonolite with small rounded vesicular aphyric ?basanite inclusion.
Basanite overlying AW86937.  Vesicular to scoriaceous, altered gray, pyroxene-feldspar basalt.
Basalt flow, 2m beneath welded flow breccia below Camp II.  Massive feldspar-clinopyroxene-olivine basanite.
Below Camp II.  Vesicular olivine-clinopyroxene/kaersutite basanite with some oxidation alteration.
Basanite with lower crustal inclusions below Camp II.  Vesicular clinopyroxene-olivine basanite.
Volcanic neck exposed by glacial erosion, below Camp II.  Kaersutite-olivine-feldspar basanite with kaersutite-feldspar inclusions.
Basanite flow infilling crater, below Camp II.  Clinopyroxene/kaersutite - olivine basanite.
Aphyric flow, below Camp II.  Vesicular, aphyric basanite with salt deposits in vesicles.
Aphyric basanite crater just below Camp II.  Partially oxidized, aphyric basanite, vesicular with micro porphyritic feldspar.
5m thick, platy flow.  Basanite fissure system forming ridge to SW Camp III.  Slightly porphyritic feldspar-phyric basalt; probably a phonolite.
Rare rounded inclusion from AW86947.  Round inclusions up to 10cm across of foliated and non-foliated lower crustal granites in various stages of being cooked.
Similar to AW86947 but further up ridge.  Sample from bomb.  Vesicular basanite with feldspar, probably xenocrysts.
Small ridge of feldspar phyric tephriphonolite on northeast side of mountain. Flow tongue of cavernously weathered hawaiite.  Coarse feldspar-phyric Benmoreite with glassy groundmass.
Pale green phonolite boulder below outcrop from cliff above.  Fresh, pale greenish gray, phonolite.  Vesicular with feldspar and ?pyroxene phenocrysts.
Phonolite flow forming cliff above Camp III.  Medium grained feldspar phonolite, buff colored.
Basalt dike cutting 'hawaiite' sequence below phonolite cliffs.  Slightly vesicular, feldspar-olivine-clinopyroxene/kaersutite basanite.
Hawaiite' from scree.  Large, platy feldspar phenocrysts and glomerocrysts in Benmoreite.
Lowermost 'hawaiite' outcrop above Camp III.  Vesicular, feldspar Benmoreite.

Lamination in quartzite.  Sequence of quartzite, chert, marble (dolomite) and possible graywacke in beds striking across ridge.
Pt. 3.  At sharp break in slope, rock is mostly fine grained quartz without phenocrysts, possible chert or fine quartzite.

Up ridge half way prominent face of bedded laminated dark quartzite and phyllite or graywacke.  Beds on order of 5-30cm, lamination fine.  Small thrust faults can be seen in face offsetting beds.  More cross beds confirm tops up.
Very dark rock again. With small porphyroclasts of actinolite developed.

Black basalt with small stilbite filled pipe amygdales in lower 20cm. Passes up into basalt with stringers and amygdales, 1m thick.

Similar black basalt, 2m thick, grading to amygdaloidal lava 4m thick.  Fine grained hypocrystalline, slightly vesicular basalt containing orthopyroxene, clinopyroxene, and plagioclase in a dark brown, glassy matrix, largely unvitrified.

Black basalt with amygdales, ledge former.  Fine grained, highly vesicular and extremely altered porphyritic basalt containing plagioclase, clinopyroxene, orthopyroxene in a largely devitrified and indistinguishable matrix.

More massive flow with pipe amygdales in lowest 10cm. Inclined to West. Passes to massive, poorly joint basalt and gradationally to amygdaloidal lava.  Fine to medium grained, highly altered porphyritic basalt, similar in appearance to 81-2-36
Amygdaloidal lava. Fine grained hypocrystalline vesicular porphyritic basalt containing plagioclase, clinopyroxene, orthopyroxene and finely disseminated iron oxides in a glassy matrix.
At 24m an outcrop of amygdaloidal lava with a pod of gray basalt (unaltered 81-2-44). Pod is about 1.5m high, then disappears laterally into scree.
At 1m in lava. Base of flow has 10cm of stilbite filled amygdales, passes to more massive gray basalt, slightly altered. Quite similar in appearance to 81-2-46, only much more vesicular and altered.

At 0.5m. Amygdaloidal base ~15cm thick, a few small pipe amygdales above, inclined SW. Also pipe column.  Passes rapidly to red weathering gray black basalt. Amygdaloidal pipes continue up to 2m above base where slope forming basalt comes in.
